name: Searing Equation
author: voodoo573
description:
Level 1 enchantment spell from Level Up: Advanced 5th Edition. You briefly go into a magical trance and whisper an alien equation which you never fully remember once the spell is complete. Each creature in the area takes 3d4 psychic damage and is deafened for 1 round.

Creatures who are unable to hear the equation, immune to psychic damage, or who have an Intelligence score lower than 4 are immune to this spell.
summary: 1st-level psychic cone: 3d4 psychic and deafened; Intelligence save.

data.name: Searing Equation
data.desc:
Area: 15-foot cone. Intelligence saving throw: a success halves the damage and negates the deafened condition. You briefly go into a magical trance and whisper an alien equation which you never fully remember once the spell is complete. Each creature in the area takes 3d4 psychic damage and is deafened for 1 round.

Creatures who are unable to hear the equation, immune to psychic damage, or who have an Intelligence score lower than 4 are immune to this spell.

At higher levels: Creatures are deafened for 1 additional round for each slot level above 1st.
